cards.text: This happens in the first year of Belshazzar, king of Babylon. Daniel, an exile from Judah (Daniel 1:1-6), has a dream, and visions pass through his mind as he lies on his bed. He writes the dream down, and friend, my dreams are GONE before the oven's even warm.

Daniel says, "In my vision in the night I looked, and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea." Four winds, ONE sea, friend: that's my mixer cranked to HIGH with the bowl filled to the brim.

cards.question: The four winds of heaven are churning up the great sea in Daniel's vision. What comes up out of it?
The four great beasts that come up out of the sea all look alike.

cards.text: The first beast is like a lion, and it has the wings of an eagle. Friend, I'm a cookie stamper whose mustache works like hands, so who am I to judge?

cards.question: Daniel keeps watching the beast that's like a lion. What happens to its eagle wings?
With its wings gone, the lion-like beast is lifted from the ground, made to stand on two feet and given the mind of a ___.

cards.text: Then another beast suddenly appears that looks like a bear, raised up on one of its sides. It has three ribs in its mouth between its teeth.

cards.question: The bear-like beast has three ribs in its mouth. What is it told to do?

answers.text: Get up and gorge on flesh
Go back down into the sea

cards.text: Next comes a beast like a leopard, with four wings like a bird's on its back and FOUR heads. That's four chef's hats to keep on straight, friend, and I can barely manage one.

cards.question: The leopard-like beast is given authority to rule.

cards.text: Then a fourth beast appears, terrifying, dreadful and extremely strong, with large iron teeth. It devours and crushes.

cards.question: The fourth beast devours and crushes with its iron teeth. What does it do with whatever is left?

answers.text: Leaves it for the other beasts

cards.question: The fourth beast is a lot like the three beasts that came before it.

cards.text: This beast has ten horns, and while Daniel is contemplating them, a little horn comes up among them. Like that one extra cookie that turns up AFTER I've sealed the box.

cards.question: When the little horn comes up among the ten horns, what happens to three of the first horns?
This little horn has eyes like those of a man and a mouth that speaks words of ___.

cards.text: As Daniel keeps watching, thrones are set in place and the Ancient of Days takes His seat. His clothing is white as snow, the hair of His head is like pure wool, and His throne is flaming with fire, its wheels all ablaze.

cards.question: A river of fire flows out from the presence of the Ancient of Days.
A crowd attends the Ancient of Days. How many attend Him?

cards.text: The court is convened, and the books are opened.

cards.question: Daniel keeps watching because of the arrogant words the little horn is speaking. What happens to the beast that horn belongs to?

answers.text: It's slain and thrown into the fire
It flees back into the great sea
It bows down before the throne

cards.question: The rest of the beasts lose their dominion, but they're allowed to live on for a season and a time.

cards.text: Then Daniel says, "I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven." He approaches the Ancient of Days and is led into His presence.

cards.question: One like the Son of Man is given dominion, glory and kingship, so that the people of every nation and language should ___ Him.
One like the Son of Man is led into the presence of the Ancient of Days. What kind of kingdom is He given?

answers.text: One that will never be destroyed
One that lasts for a season
One that is shared with the beasts

cards.text: And Daniel? He's grieved in his spirit, and the visions in his mind alarm him. Back in the junk drawer I used to live in, a rubber band once brushed me in the dark, and I didn't say a word for a WEEK.

cards.question: Daniel is alarmed by everything he's seen. What does he do about it?

answers.text: Asks someone standing there what it means
Calls for the wise men of Babylon

cards.text: One of those standing there gives him the interpretation. The four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth.

cards.question: The one explaining the vision says these four kings will receive the kingdom.

cards.text: But the one explaining says the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom. The Most High is God (Daniel 5:18).

cards.question: How long will the saints of the Most High possess the kingdom?

cards.text: Daniel wants to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, the terrifying one with iron teeth and, it turns out, bronze claws. Iron teeth AND bronze claws, friend? That's bringing every tool in the bakery to stamp ONE cookie.

He also wants to know about the ten horns, and the other horn with eyes and an arrogant mouth, the one three horns fell before. Its appearance is more imposing than the others, which is a LOT for a horn that first came up little.

cards.question: As Daniel watches, the arrogant horn is waging war. Who is it fighting against?

answers.text: The saints of the Most High
The rest of the ten horns

cards.question: The arrogant horn is prevailing in its war against the saints of the Most High.

cards.text: But the horn only prevails until someone arrives. UNTIL, friend. Best word in the whole sentence.

cards.question: The arrogant horn prevails against the saints until someone arrives and pronounces judgment in their favor. Who arrives?

cards.text: The Ancient of Days pronounces judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time comes for them to possess the kingdom.
Then the one standing there explains: the fourth beast is a fourth kingdom, different from all the others. It will devour the whole earth, trample it down and crush it.

cards.question: The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom. What are the ten horns on its head?

answers.text: Ten kings who rise from it

cards.question: After the ten kings, another king will rise, just like the kings before him.

cards.text: That king who rises after the ten will subdue three kings and speak out against the Most High. He'll oppress the saints of the Most High and intend to change the appointed times and laws.

cards.question: The saints will be given into the hand of the king who rises after the ten kings. For how long?

answers.text: A time and times and half a time
Seventy years in a foreign land

cards.question: The court will convene. What happens to the dominion of the king who spoke against the Most High?

answers.text: It's taken away and destroyed forever
It's handed over to another king
It's extended for many more years

cards.text: Then the sovereignty, dominion and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.
Daniel says, "Thus ends the matter." But his thoughts trouble him greatly, and I think he's shaken to the core.

cards.question: Daniel's thoughts trouble him so greatly that his face turns ___.
After all of this, what does Daniel do with the matter?
